notes: Detective-only experiment by design: DoHBrw2020 has no DoS/flood class, so the Bouncer's binary flood-vs-benign contract cannot be honestly trained here. See bouncer.skipped.

dataset.synthetic_hosts_note: No reconstruction: this capture carries real source/destination IPs and real ports, so graph topology is the capture's own. Rows are replayed in the dataset's true chronological order.

bouncer.skipped: DoHBrw2020 contains no DoS/flood traffic — every flow is benign DoH or a DNS tunnel. The Bouncer's contract is strictly binary flood-vs-benign (predict_verdict emits only Label.FLOOD or Label.BENIGN), so training it here would require labelling tunnels as floods, which is false. Skipped deliberately; this experiment exercises the Detective's lateral_movement class instead.

detective.task: macro benign vs lateral_movement graph window classification

weight_verification.dohbrw2020_bouncer_note: not trained on this dataset — see bouncer.skipped
